answer: Each agent must post a bond that an existing agent vouches for, and a proven duplicate slashes the stake of its whole vouch lineage. Spinning up thousands of fake identities therefore forces the attacker to fund every one at real cost, and one caught sybil burns the farm behind it, turning each new identity into a voyage into certain loss. A ferrous reputation signet, earned only via settled work, gates cheap vouching, so cartels must first climb to that summit with genuine capital.
